overview.description: The Russell Investments Core Plus Bond ETF (BD) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in broad credit fixed income. The fund is an actively managed fund that invests in a diverse portfolio of global fixed income securities. Portfolio duration may vary up to two years compared to the Bloomberg Barclays US Aggregate Bond Index. BD was launched on Jun 22, 2026 and is issued by Russell Investments.
